jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer – AMD/Xilinx RFSoC
jobs.description: Embedded Software Engineer - AMD/Xilinx RFSoC - Netline Communication Technologies Embedded Software Engineer – AMD/Xilinx RFSoC Job Description: TNG is seeking an experienced Embedded Software Engineer to join a team of top-tier professionals developing a high-performance system built on the AMD/Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+ RFSoC platform. This system will form the core technology behind the company’s future RF and wireless products, spanning secure cellular communications, signal-emission detection, and protection against communications exploitation. Responsibilities include: Develop embedded C/C++ software for the RFSoC’s Arm Cortex-A53 and Cortex-R5F processors in embedded Linux, FreeRTOS, and bare-metal environments. Configure RF ADC/RF-DAC resources, AXI and DMA data paths, interrupts, clocks, NCOs, interpolation, decimation, and multi-tile synchronization. Support RFSoC board bring-up, FPGA integration, debugging, and system validation. Implement detection infrastructure and embedded algorithms to identify anomalous or unauthorized activity. Develop and optimize end-to-end, high-performance PCIe/DMA software solutions across embedded and host platforms, including low-level Linux drivers, user-space components, APIs, libraries, multithreaded applications, and automated performance testing. Job Requirements: Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. Strong embedded and system-level development experience in C and C++. Experience with Linux kernel development, device drivers, kernel modules, and user-space hardware interfaces. Experience with PCI Express, and DMA-based data transfer. Practical knowledge of AMD/Xilinx XDMA IP and Linux XDMA drivers. Experience developing multithreaded applications on Ubuntu or another Linux distribution. Experience with AMD/Xilinx Zynq, MPSoC, or RFSoC platforms and tools such as Vitis, Vivado, and PetaLinux. Knowledge of AXI, DMA, DDR, interrupts, memory mapping, cache coherency, and buffer management. Experience designing APIs and interfaces between kernel drivers, user-space libraries, and applications. Understanding ADC/DAC operation, sampling, I/Q processing, NCOs, interpolation, decimation, and FFT analysis. Strong debugging and performance-analysis skills using JTAG, GDB, ILA, kernel logs, tracing, and profiling tools. Ability to apply oscilloscope and spectrum analyzer. Ability to work closely with FPGA, RF, DSP, hardware, and system engineering teams. Knowledge of LTE / 5G Cellular technology is major advantage.
